packageRules.description: Do not create pin-only PRs. Libraries must use SemVer ranges (e.g. ^1.0.0)
Group all non-major devDependency updates to reduce noise
Never automerge major updates (Runtime or Dev)
Runtime and build-script patch updates: Automerge after soak.
Runtime and build-script minor updates: Automerge after a longer soak. Required CI covers all tier-1 platforms.
GitHub Actions digest updates (same tag, new commit): automerge.

Special logic for wreq. Track pre-releases and automerge if tests pass. In Aug 2026 upstream renumbered both crates downward (wreq 6.0.0-rc.31 -> 0.16.0, wreq-util 3.0.0-rc.14 -> 0.2.0), so crates.io still reports the abandoned rc line as max_version. allowedVersions keeps us on the current 0.x line instead of being dragged back. See https://github.com/0x676e67/wreq/issues/1254
